title: v0.33.0
excerpt: v0.33.0 Highlights This release features 927 commits from 389 contributors (122 new)! New models : Reflection Beam-1.0 (501B MoE, 23B active) with its DFlash2 drafter ( #62074 ), Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B ( #57963 ), Recursive Flint (40B MoE, 2.5B active) ( #62938 ), Muse Spark Open ( #61879 ), Step-5 Preview ( #61727 , #63147 ), NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super ( #62957 ), Nemotron-Labs Dory1.0-4B ( #60149 ), Nemotron Parse 3.5 ( #61651 ), MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 ( #63095 ), Domyn Edge ( #62544 ) and the ColUltraVBERT visual document retriever ( #62237 ). PyTorch 2.14 : vLLM is upgraded to PyTorch 2.14.0, with torchvision 0.29.0 and Triton 3.8.0 ( #52183 ). CUDA 12.9 dropped : release wheels and images are CUDA 13.0 only. The CUDA 12.9 wheels and the -cu129 / -cu129-ubuntu2404 images are no longer published ( #62575 ); use the default CUDA 13.0 artifacts instead. libtorch ABI stable CUDA wheel : the CUDA wheel is now ABI stable with libtorch. AWS EFA image : a new vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0-efa image (x86_64 and aarch64) bundles the AWS EFA libraries and the EFA build of the Mooncake transfer engine, for KV transfer and multi-node serving on EFA-enabled EC2 instances ( #58768 ). vllm/vllm image alias : every release image is now also published under the shorter vllm/vllm name, e.g. vllm/vllm:v0.33.0 , vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-efa and vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm .
